# Pymatic Labs · Cerebro Digital (Digital Brain)

> Pymatic Labs (PYMATICLABS, S.L., Castellón de la Plana, Spain) makes the Cerebro Digital / Digital Brain: a company's knowledge, digitized and indexed so any AI can look it up, and an AI (Claude) that can also run the company's processes on request. It lives on the customer's own computers. Sold only to businesses and professionals (B2B).

## What it is
- The company's memory: how things are done, criteria, reference data and where each document is. It answers citing the source document.
- It runs written procedures step by step and learns new ones when the user approves them.
- It lives on the customer's computers (Mac and Windows), not in the cloud. Pymatic Labs never receives the brain or the passwords.
- It works with Claude (Claude Desktop and Cowork, also from a phone). It is set up without a terminal, through a Claude Desktop extension.
- Teams: up to 10 people on the same brain, with locked areas.
- It never opens health files, never copies passwords and asks for approval before changing anything.

## Pricing (EUR, excluding VAT, one-off payment, perpetual license per company)
- Do it yourself (Hazlo tú): €990 list, €500 launch price.
- Do it yourself, team: €1,990 list, €1,000 launch price.
- Guided (Acompañado): €1,990 list, €1,000 launch price. Outcome: 3 to 5 of the customer's processes set up and documents loaded.
- Guided, team: €3,490 list, €2,000 launch price.
- Launch prices apply to the first 10 customers.
- All include two 1-hour setup sessions and a 14-day setup guarantee (not a satisfaction guarantee).
- Optional monthly service plans: Essential €99, Pro €199, Premium €299 per month. Cancel anytime; the brain keeps working without them.
- Security fixes are free for every customer during the version's support period.
- Spain Pack: €1,990. Custom builds: from €10,000.
- North America: the same numbers in USD.
